EN: King of kings

Your control over the rulers in your faction is not absolute; as long as they do not oppose you they are free to act politically and militarily to their own advantage. To different degrees, each ruler has a right to be the ruler of their system and you will find it hard to justify replacing them.

The potential for powerful and discontent rulers to rebel or change allegiance is high. Work to keep your vassals loyalty, but also keep an eye out for opportunities to seduce a neighbour's vassals.<helptext>

Exploiting the law

As a leader, you are responsible for the fate of your subjects. To be considered honorable, you must seek justice on their behalf when they are wronged. Other leaders may also demand that you mete out justice for them or their subjects, and may go to war if you do not.

The responsibility to punish your subjects for their crimes is a useful political tool, however it is dishonorable to punish excessively or to punish subjects who have not committed any crimes.<helptext>

Knowledge is power

The galaxy can be a ruthless place, and many individuals have a lot to hide. So will you, inevitably, act in secret to get what you want sometimes. You can topple others from power, directly or indirectly by revealing their secrets, and taking advantage of how others turn against them, especially if they have committed crimes or betrayed others.

Our security team will try to ferret out the secrets that you can use to bring someone into disrepute, as well as hide your secrets.<helptext>
